description: Dual-arm EE poses for the table mission. Reached through the joint servo and the site joint_impedance_controller, never through PTP: the same path the grasp chunk uses. travel_stow is required; camera_clear and grasp_ready are optional and are skipped while null, in which case the stage detects and grasps from the pose the arms are already in.

travel_stow.description: Both arms folded inside the navigation footprint (front/rear 0.40 m, width 0.58 m from start_to_pickup.yaml) so the base collision envelope holds while driving. Captured from the live arms on 2026-09-07. Arm poses only: the spine height at capture time was not trusted, so this posture is reached at whatever travel height the mission commands.

camera_clear.description: Both arms retracted clear of the head ZED view. The right arm hid half the tray during the 2026-09-07 dry run, so an empty view must be confirmed before detection is trusted.

grasp_ready.description: Grasp start posture. Left reaches the bowl, right reaches the cup. grasp_cup_bowl builds its chunk from the current pose, so this is the anchor it starts from.

approach.comment: Interpolation bounds for the transfer chunk into each pose. Kept at or below the grasp step limits so the impedance controller sees the same continuity it was tuned for.
